title: Booking three bikes at once
_dead_note: The capture opens and closes on the macOS wallpaper, with white flash frames between it and the app. Scene 1 starts at 2.33s and the last scene ends at 107.47s, so no junk is inside any segment. The MASTER is untouched.
_frames_note: `frames` on each scene is its own footage at 30fps — the rate was MEASURED, never assumed 25.

scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Three bikes on one booking. Enter your email for a code.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your order opens empty, so add yourself to it first.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Open a collection and start with the mountain bike. Each collection holds one kind, and the size and colour are chosen right here on the row.

scenes.label: first-dates
scenes.line: Pick the day you collect it, then the day you bring it back.

scenes.label: second-catalogue
scenes.line: Back to the catalogue for the second, a boys bike this time. Size and colour again on the row.

scenes.label: second-dates
scenes.line: Each bike gets its own dates, so one can go out longer than another.

scenes.label: third-catalogue
scenes.line: Once more for an electric bike. There is no limit while the order is open, and the running total follows along.

scenes.label: third-dates
scenes.line: Dates for the third, the same way as the others.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Now your age and your height. We set every frame and saddle from these, so three bikes is no more work than one. Then agree to the terms.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: All three bikes sit together in your order history.
